correction_rule: Owner correction supersedes the mistaken interpretation, updates the durable alias/source binding, preserves the prior interpretation as history when material, and prevents the same known source/name from requiring repeated research.
appointment_title_rule: Generate the human-facing title from canonical entity/category data and user preferences, never from unsupported diagnosis inference.

delivery.canonical_object: one reminder intent per trigger after deduplication
delivery.client_responsibility: Native client performs TTS/audio routing. Server supplies canonical speech text and timing but does not claim direct control of a Bluetooth hearing aid or speaker route.

android.voice_generation: Use the Android device's selected Text-to-Speech engine locally. The reminder service supplies speech text and timing; the device synthesizes the audio.
android.verification_rule: Mark spoken_notification healthy only after an actual device test/readback or equivalent observed delivery evidence.
